consumer_warning.title: Scam alert: fake Kilimani Glow page
consumer_warning.body:
Fake page alert: @kiiimaniglow is not Kilimani Glow.
Don't send money to 0745 600 700.
Pay only via Paybill 400200 (KILIMANI GLOW) through @kilimaniglow.
Please report the fake page and share this message with friends and family.

platform_takedown.body:
I am reporting an account that is impersonating my business, Kilimani Glow.

Impersonating account: @kiiimaniglow (https://instagram.com/kiiimaniglow)
Our official account(s): @kilimaniglow (instagram), @kilimaniglow (facebook)

Evidence recorded by Halisi (first seen 2026-09-26):
- Profile picture: perceptual-hash distance 28/64 from our registered logo (visual similarity 60%).
- Name/handle similarity to our official account: 100%.
- It asks customers to pay 0745 600 700, which is not registered to our business.
- Its name imitates Kilimani Glow's official account @kilimaniglow.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Kilimani Glow's official payment channel.
- Uses a logo 60% similar to Kilimani Glow's.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'order now'.

Please remove this account. It uses our identity to take payments from our customers.

safaricom_report.subject: Fraud report: M-Pesa number used to impersonate Kilimani Glow
safaricom_report.body:
Dear Safaricom fraud team,

I am reporting M-Pesa payment details used by a fake social-media page that impersonates my business, Kilimani Glow.

Receiving number(s) on the fake page: 0745 600 700
Fake page: @kiiimaniglow on instagram (https://instagram.com/kiiimaniglow), first seen 2026-09-26.
Our official payment channel: Pay only via Paybill 400200 (KILIMANI GLOW) through @kilimaniglow.

How customers are misled:
- Its name imitates Kilimani Glow's official account @kilimaniglow.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Kilimani Glow's official payment channel.
- Uses a logo 60% similar to Kilimani Glow's.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'order now'.

Please investigate the payment details above. Scam SMS can also be forwarded to <Safaricom scam-SMS forwarding short code: confirm on safaricom.co.ke (commonly cited as 333)>.

kecirt_report.body:

Account reported: @kiiimaniglow on instagram (https://instagram.com/kiiimaniglow)
First seen: 2026-09-26
Our official account(s): @kilimaniglow (instagram), @kilimaniglow (facebook)
Payment details shown on the account: 0745 600 700

Evidence recorded by Halisi:
- Profile picture perceptual-hash distance 28/64 from our registered logo.
- Overall impersonation score 90/100 (confidence 0.9).
- Its name imitates Kilimani Glow's official account @kilimaniglow.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Kilimani Glow's official payment channel.
- Uses a logo 60% similar to Kilimani Glow's.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'order now'.

I am available to provide further information.
